sermon.title: Adding Love: You are to Blame
sermon.series: Bible Morality Banned by Wimps and Born by Warriors
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: After citing a homosexual couple’s court-documented child sexual abuse and challenging pride in gay identity amid HIV/AIDS stats, the speaker blames humanists since the 1960s, Obama and Democrats, silent Republicans, pastors and a pope soft on evolution/homosexuality, silent Christians, and NEA/AFT for school secularization. He calls Christians out of the closet as warriors who obey God’s laws, protect neighbors, and make laws that convert or remove criminals—and asks whether America has added love and the other 2 Peter qualities.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. MOST SENSITIVE of batch: graphic sexual language about gay acts (kept in transcript as spoken; short answers paraphrase without repeating genital detail); child sexual abuse case; names Apple CEO; Obama; Democratic/Republican parties; pope; NEA/AFT; unverified stats (HIV, 30k deaths, 52% Democrats liberal humanist, 30 functionally illiterate). Accusatory politics throughout. Keep as spoken for Michael’s review. Speaker not named—confirm Kincer. Real names kept out of short answers/FAQ where possible (use roles).

chunks.short_answer: He describes a homosexual couple in the newspapers who obtained a baby boy and, per court record, sexually abused him from 22 months to age six, videotaped it, taught it as normal, and involved other men—while publicly praised as a happy couple. He asks if such people will listen.
chunks.text: These guys. They are a homosexual couple. They made the newspapers how they were married. You know, I’ve been married all these years. And then the guy on the left decides that they want a child. So they get the baby. It’s a boy. At 22 months they started playing with his pp. This is the court record. They start letting him fondle their pp. They fly him all over the world for money to let other men play with his pp and their pp. And this went on until the boy was six years old when they got caught. And the reason they got caught—they videotaped everything. And somebody got a hold of one of the tapes and go, this isn’t normal. And all the while they’re in the newspapers—man, look at this happy homosexual couple, oh boy they got their own kid—and all the time they were sexually molesting this boy and teaching this boy that this was a normal lifestyle. That’s right in the court records. They arrested several other men that they had on video sexually abusing this boy. You think they’re going to listen?

chunks.short_answer: Responding to an Apple CEO saying he is proud to be gay, he asks what sexual acts one is proud of, cites millions with HIV and over 30,000 North American deaths yearly from AIDS/STDs, and asks how that pride relates to molesters—saying somebody needs to say this from the church.
chunks.text: Just this week Apple CEO come out and I’m proud to be gay. I write and say, what are you proud of? Are you proud to stick your penis in the butthole of another man and then in his mouth—is that what you’re proud of? Are you proud to let another man stick his penis in your butthole and then in your mouth—is that something to be proud of? You see, this needs to be said on the news. We need to get into their acts. Are you proud of the fact that millions of Americans have HIV and over 30,000 in North America die each year from AIDS and sexually transmitted disease? Are you proud of that, Mr. Rich CEO? Are you proud to be in the same company as these two guys molesting children, molesting teenagers—or is that why you’re proud of? Please explain to me how you can say you’re proud to be a homosexual. But no one will hit these. Jesus—oh whoa, pastor, you’re talking like that from the front of the church? Somebody needs to say something.

chunks.text: I challenge the humanist and the humanist followers. Their policies do not work, and statistics have proved it. We’ve given you the statistics in this subject. Humanist, you must take responsibility and accountability for the destructive direction America has gone since you’ve been in control from the 1960s, and change your policies to approve Jesus Christ and Bible moralities. That is my challenge to the humanists, the liberals, and the followers of humanism.

The purpose of the church is to promote, provoke, stir up, encourage to love one another—not hurt one another, not do evil things—and to do good works. And we’re embracing everything. The pope—this pope they got—he embraces evolution, says evolution has no problem with the Bible. He just said that homosexual couples could be a benefit to the church. Adulterers and fornicators and pedophiles and all the rest can’t even be a member of the church. But we don’t even talk about adultery anymore or fornication anymore. We’re just callous to that. Pastors on radio and TV are not addressing the homosexual issue and the evolution that they’re embracing. You’re to blame.

chunks.text: And Christians who say evolution is Bible and evolution is science—it’s a lie. Just do simple—any idiot with a fifth-grade education can realize that evolution has not given us any evidence at all. Just a lot of rhetoric. And same-sex marriage. And you Christians out there—you sit in church, you go to church every Sunday and you worship and you got the music you like because the churches are putting the music you like so you can go to church and you can have the same music that you listen to through the week on the way to work, and you’re happy with that, and you’re told that you’re doing great and everything is fine and God loves you and it doesn’t matter what—nothing bad is going to happen to you because you believe in Christ. You allow them to bring evolution in without another opinion, another voice to challenge it. You allow them to take prayer out of the public school. You allow them to dumb down the academics to where kids—30 of them—can’t even functionally read. They’re functionally illiterate. chunks.text: And humanists and all their followers including Christians—you’re to blame for the condition of America. Now we can change it if you change your thinking and you start speaking up right. We can change America. Humanist, you have brought homosexuals, pedophiles, and everything else out of the closet—transvestites and everything else—and you in these 50 years has forced the real Christian, the real moral person into the closet. I challenge the Christians today to come out of the closet and start speaking truth. Amen. chunks.section_question: Has America added love and the other qualities to faith?
chunks.short_answer: He asks whether America has added love, brotherly love, knowledge, self-control, patience, virtue, and godliness. Closeted Christians must add and come out; humanists must add these and change policies toward righteous laws to make America great again.
chunks.text: Now, are you a wimp or a warrior? If we’re going to love God who Jesus is, we have to obey his laws. A warrior obeys. A warrior doesn’t just take the name of Christ. A warrior lives it and speaks it. If we’re going to love our neighbor, we’re not going to do anything verbally, physically, financially, or spiritually to hurt them. A warrior stands up for morality. If we love the criminal that is hurting us and our nation, we will create and carry out laws that convert them to Bible morals or remove them from society. And this is what the Democrats and the Republicans both need to hear. We need some action instead of a lot of debates that don’t even hit issues. It’s all about how bad this guy is and how bad this guy is, and we’re tired of hearing attacks on people. Give us clear issue understanding and action.
